_notes.purpose: Copy to config.json and fill every seam. JSON has no comments, so each seam carries a sibling _notes entry documenting provenance. Never commit a filled config.json.
_notes.packagedSkillRoot: Path to the installed packaged oat-explainer-kit skill (post-migration: the RC 1.0.0 subtree). Provenance: install location chosen during migration.
_notes.vaultRoot: Personal vault root for explainer output. Provenance: same value used by the 0.4.1 backup wrapper (see the backup's config).
_notes.googleDocs: Export wiring for the Google Docs destination. exportCommand is an argv array invoked with the manifest path appended; wiringRef names where the wiring lives. Provenance: 0.4.1 backup's gdocs integration.
_notes.publish: Personal published destinations. Each preset pins corresponding s3Uri/publicBaseUrl roots per destination-contract.md; cloudFrontDistributionId is the personal distribution. Provenance: 0.4.1 backup's destination config.
_notes.backupPath: Rollback source: the pre-migration wrapper backup. Confirmed stoa-side at ~/.agents/skills-backup/oat-explainer-kit-0.4.1.
_notes.acceptance: Acceptance-run inputs: a valid supplied fact-base file, the recipe pin, and the human gate for the publish leg (allowPublish stays false until the operator explicitly enables the end-to-end publish test).
_notes.finalRc: Post-p06 final RC pins. These are PLACEHOLDERS pinned at the final freeze by the explainer-kit project; do not run acceptance until all three are filled. The f212d630 schemas remain the contract basis.

packagedSkillRoot: <fill: absolute path to installed oat-explainer-kit skill root>
vaultRoot: <fill: absolute path to personal vault root>

googleDocs.wiringRef: <fill: reference to the gdocs wiring location, from the 0.4.1 backup>

backupPath: <fill: absolute path to the oat-explainer-kit-0.4.1 backup tree>

acceptance.factBasePath: <fill: absolute path to a valid explainer-kit.fact-base/v1 JSON file>

finalRc.subtreeSha256: <pin final oat-explainer-kit subtree hash at post-p06 freeze>
